claims.text: Lactulose (portal-systemic encephalopathy): usual adult dose 30 to 45 mL three or four times daily;
claims.quote: The usual adult, oral dosage is 2 to 3 tablespoonfuls (30 to 45 ml, containing 20 g to 30 g of lactulose) three or four times daily.

claims.text: hourly 30 to 45 mL doses may be used for rapid initial laxation, then reduced to the daily dose.
claims.quote: Hourly doses of 30 to 45 ml of Lactulose may be used to induce the rapid laxation indicated in the initial phase of the therapy of portal-systemic encephalopathy. When the laxative effect has been achieved, the dose of lactulose may then be reduced to the recommended daily dose.
